summary: Frontend-only, read-only test of the Cotizaciones > Filtros Rápidos changes: the new 'Grupo Económico' filter and the Cliente search by fantasy name. Logged in as admin rgonzalez. The preview DB has only 2 quotes (TRACTOCAMIONES and TPI REPUESTOS), and neither client belongs to a group. With real data the group popover correctly shows only 'Todos los grupos', matching the API. To test the positive cases without writing to the DB, I intercepted GET /api/quotes in Playwright (page.route) and added fake quotes for SALUS 7 (Grupo Brasero), SJB 777 (Grupo Brasero), EXCELSIOR MARKET (GRUPO EXCELSIOR) and the sucursal CUBITT MARACAIBO. I also added archived quotes for FARMA EXCELSIOR and HALE 444. Results: only groups with active quotes are listed (Grupo Brasero 2 clientes, GRUPO EXCELSIOR 1, Rower 1). Clients with only archived quotes are left out of the group ids. filter-group-search works ('brase' -> Grupo Brasero; 'zzzz' -> 'Sin coincidencias'). Picking Grupo Brasero filters the grid to its 2 quotes and recalculates the KPIs (total 2, borrador 1, enviada 1). Grupo + Estado=Enviada leaves 1 row. Cliente(SJB) + Grupo + Enviada leaves 1 row; with Borrador, 0 rows. The Cliente search matches by fantasy name: 'Brasero El Marq' finds INVERSIONES SALUS 7 C.A. with subtitle 'Brasero El Marqúez'. Search by razón social ('salus') and by another fantasy name ('barako') also works. clear-filters-btn resets Cliente, Grupo and Estado, restores all rows and KPIs, and hides itself. A sucursal inherits the principal's group id. Layout at 1920: the 7 filters sit in one row at the same y position, about 159px each, with no overlap.

ui_bugs.issue: The group label is taken from the client's own denormalized `grupo_economico` before the principal's, but the key uses the principal's `grupo_economico_id`. Real data: the sucursales of DISTRIBUIDORA ROWER (cli_d5a4e0ea9050, cli_51e45eb9a168, cli_0d40ee105d2e) have grupo_economico='Rower' and no id. Their principal cli_2503893281a8 has grp_a80ef506f35b, whose real name in /api/grupos-economicos is 'Casiolandia', and its grupo_economico field is null. The filter would show 'Rower' (or 'Grupo sin nombre' if the principal itself had a quote) instead of 'Casiolandia'. The name is also fixed by whichever client comes first, so a group whose first member has no name stays 'Grupo sin nombre' even if a later member has one.

issues: The page content is capped at about 1000px, so each of the 7 filters is about 159px wide. Trigger text gets cut off ('Todos los clien...', 'Todos los grup...', 'Todas las categor'). Selected client names will also be truncated. Consider a wider container or a 2-row layout at xl.

action_items: In groupsWithActiveQuotes, take the group name from the principal (or from the /api/grupos-economicos catalog by id) when the key comes from the principal's grupo_economico_id. Fill in a missing name from later members or from the catalog instead of keeping 'Grupo sin nombre'.
Optional: widen the filter grid at 1920 so the trigger labels are not truncated.
critical_code_review_comments: Quotes.jsx is about 4760 lines; it should be split.

The data has inconsistencies: 69 clients reference grupo_economico_id values that are missing from the /api/grupos-economicos catalog (45 groups), and some sucursales keep stale group names. The current approach based on denormalized names hides most of this, but the label and key can disagree.
QuotesTable does not exclude archived quotes itself; it relies on the backend not returning them. The KPIs and the group/client lists do exclude archived quotes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; 1 low-priority labeling issue

seed_data_creation: None. Positive cases used in-browser mocking of GET /api/quotes (page.route); nothing was written to the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth: POST /api/auth/login returns session_token. Put it in localStorage 'session_token' plus 'user', then go to /quotes. The preview DB has only 2 quotes and both clients have no group, so mock /api/quotes (regex .*/api/quotes(\?.*)?$) to test group cases. Grupo Brasero members: cli_874a6ea688e9 (SALUS 7 / Brasero El Marqúez), cli_40e36f150d9d (SJB 777 / Barako), cli_bd12925ab654, cli_2657337835da. Group option testid = filter-group-option-{comma-joined client ids}. KPI values: quotes-kpi-{total|borrador|enviada|aprobada|facturada|pagada}-value.
